setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Install Rust
steps.body: Run the single command the page shows, then reopen Terminal.
steps.verifierLabel: cargo responds with a version number

expect.prompt: In the terminal, has the rustup installer finished — a line such as "Rust is installed now. Great!", with the prompt back and no error? Answer not done while it is still downloading or still asking which installation option to use.

hints: Paste the command rustup.rs shows into Terminal and take the default install.
Already finished? Open a new Terminal window — cargo only joins the PATH of new shells.

steps.title: Install uv
steps.body: uv manages the Python side of the app; the build stages it into the bundle.

expect.prompt: In the terminal, has the uv installer finished — lines like "downloading uv" followed by "everything's installed!", with the prompt back and no error? Answer not done while it is still downloading.

hints: The command downloads and runs uv's official installer — give it a moment.
Installed but not found later? Open a new Terminal window so ~/.local/bin joins the PATH.

steps.title: Copy publikclip to this Mac
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d publikclip/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/publikclip.git
fi

hints: If it stopped partway, delete the publikclip folder and run the command again.
Permission denied? Run it from your home folder rather than a synced or network drive.

steps.title: Open the publikclip folder
steps.verifierLabel: Your terminal prompt is inside the publikclip folder

steps.title: Install the interface packages
steps.verifierLabel: The install finishes without an error

steps.title: Build the app
steps.body: The first build compiles the Rust shell, so it takes several minutes.
steps.verifierLabel: A publikclip.app appears in the bundle folder

steps.title: Put publikclip in Applications
steps.body: Copy the freshly built app into Applications so it's a real, launchable Mac app.
steps.verifierLabel: publikclip.app is in your Applications folder

steps.title: Open publikclip
steps.body: Built on your own machine, so macOS opens it without any warning dialog.

steps.title: Pick the scoring brain
steps.body: In onboarding, paste a free Gemini key (aistudio.google.com) — or pick Ollama if you run it.

hints: Get a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey — sign in, Create API key, copy it.
Running Ollama instead? Nothing to paste — continue once onboarding lets you through.

steps.title: Feed it an hour
steps.body: Paste a YouTube link and hit CUT IT. First run downloads the speech models (~4–5 GB).
steps.verifierLabel: Scored clips appear in the review screen
